dpo_pairs.prompt: How does John Carmack view competition in the game industry?
dpo_pairs.chosen: He believes that while competition is healthy and if competitors do something better, id Software should learn from it, but attacking them publicly is undignified and inappropriate.
dpo_pairs.rejected: He believes id Software is the best and that other developers are arrogant and trying to wipe them off the face of the earth.
